source: a public collection of SC-55/88/88Pro SMFs, loose .mid entries plus the .lzh/.zip archives unpacked, fetched 2026-08-29
_selection_columns: A melodic program change selects a tone and a rhythm one selects a kit out of a different 128-number space, so the two are never added together. `bank_msb` is the GS variation number and `bank_lsb` the tone map; GM2 uses both differently and is told apart by an MSB of 120 or 121, so neither is folded. Rank by `files`, not by `count`.
